Normal Retry returned genuine HTTP 200: criterion-9-genuine-recovery.png shows the recovered one-row target list, and criterion-9-recovered-detail.png shows member 132714574 with 0.845 s. This complete baseline/error/recovery sequence supports the scoped UI pass; the no-data alternative was not fabricated or claimed.
